:::{#def-lebesgue-measure}
#### Lebesgue measure

**Lebesgue measure** on $\reals$
[@wikipedia_lebesgue_measure]
is the [measure](#def-measure) $\lebesgue$
on the [Borel $\sigma$-algebra](#def-borel-sigma-algebra) $\borel$
that assigns each [interval](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/sets.html#def-interval) its length: <!-- check-term-links: allow -->
for real numbers $a \le b$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\lebesgue([a, b])
&= \lebesgue((a, b)) \\
&= \lebesgue([a, b)) \\
&= \lebesgue((a, b]) \\
&\eqdef b - a,
\end{aligned}
$$

and $\lebesgue(I) \eqdef \infty$ for each unbounded interval $I$.

:::
